desc: task_1_mst: Read graph, run Kruskal to produce MST edges (u,v,w).
task_2_lca: Preprocess MST for binary lifting LCA and max-edge-on-path queries.
task_3_virtual: Build virtual tree from A and B nodes using Euler tour order, compute edge costs (max weight) using LCA queries.
task_4_dp: Run DP on virtual tree: pair A's and B's to minimize sum of edge costs; maintain a multiset of "open A's" passing up.
task_5_solve: Integrate all steps and print the final minimal sum.
